description: We are Nova Squad, a software-focused team tackling the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge. Led by a full-stack developer skilled in Python, PHP, Node.js, and futuristic HUD design, we are building a spacecraft-style cockpit to map safe lunar landing zones using real NASA elevation data. Join us if you want to build a standout, winning project. We need frontend/3D developers (Three.js/WebGL), geospatial data analysts, and a sharp pitch strategist. Let's build the future of lunar navigation!
